title: Trello Card
description: A Trello card is the fundamental unit of work on a board. Cards live within lists and can have members, labels, checklists, attachments, due dates, and comments.

id.description: The unique identifier for the card.

desc.description: The description of the card, supporting Markdown formatting.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the card is on.

idList.description: The ID of the list the card is in.

idShort.description: The short numeric identifier for the card within its board.

idMembers.description: The IDs of members assigned to the card.

idLabels.description: The IDs of labels applied to the card.

idChecklists.description: The IDs of checklists on the card.

idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of the attachment used as the card cover image.

pos.description: The position of the card in its list.

due.description: The due date for the card.

dueComplete.description: Whether the due date has been marked as complete.

start.description: The start date for the card.

url.description: The full URL of the card.

shortUrl.description: The short URL of the card.

shortLink.description: The short link identifier for the card.

subscribed.description: Whether the authenticated member is subscribed to the card.

dateLastActivity.description: The date and time of the last activity on the card.

labels.description: The full label objects applied to the card.

customFieldItems.description: Custom field values set on the card.

CardCover.description: The card's cover image or color settings.

idAttachment.description: The ID of the attachment used as the cover.

idUploadedBackground.description: The ID of an uploaded background used as the cover.

size.description: The size of the cover display.

idPlugin.description: The ID of the plugin providing the cover.

CardBadges.description: Badge counts and indicators displayed on the card front.

votes.description: Number of votes on the card.

attachments.description: Number of attachments on the card.

comments.description: Number of comments on the card.

checkItems.description: Total number of check items across all checklists.

description.description: Whether the card has a description.

due.description: The due date displayed on the badge.

dueComplete.description: Whether the due date is complete.

start.description: The start date for the card.

Label.description: A color-coded label applied to a card for categorization.

id.description: The unique identifier for the label.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label belongs to.

CustomFieldItem.description: A custom field value set on a card.

id.description: The unique identifier for the custom field item.

idCustomField.description: The ID of the custom field definition.

idModel.description: The ID of the card this value is set on.

value.description: The value of the custom field, with a key matching the field type.

number.description: Value for number-type custom fields (string representation).

checked.description: Value for checkbox-type custom fields ('true' or 'false').

idValue.description: The ID of the selected option for list-type custom fields.
